SELECT country_live AS country_live, COUNT(*) AS count, count(country_live) AS "COUNT(country_live)" 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE is_software_dev = 1 GROUP BY country_live 
 LIMIT 10000

SELECT count(is_software_dev) AS "COUNT(is_software_dev)" 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE CASE WHEN is_software_dev = 0 THEN 'Aspiring Developer' WHEN is_software_dev = 1 THEN 'Currently A Developer' END = 'Currently A Developer' 
 LIMIT 50000;

SELECT last_yr_income AS last_yr_income 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE CASE WHEN is_software_dev = 0 THEN 'Aspiring Developer' WHEN is_software_dev = 1 THEN 'Currently A Developer' END = 'Currently A Developer' AND last_yr_income <= 100000 
 LIMIT 50000;

SELECT job_pref AS job_pref, school_degree AS school_degree, COUNT(*) AS count 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE is_software_dev = 0 AND school_degree != 'NULL' AND job_pref != 'NULL' GROUP BY job_pref, school_degree ORDER BY job_pref ASC, school_degree ASC 
 LIMIT 50000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE is_software_dev = 0 
 LIMIT 50000;

SELECT job_pref AS job_pref, COUNT(*) AS count 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE is_software_dev = 0 AND job_pref != 'NULL' GROUP BY job_pref ORDER BY job_pref ASC 
 LIMIT 10;

SELECT time_start AS time_start, school_degree AS school_degree, sum(last_yr_income) AS "SUM(last_yr_income)" 
FROM public."FCC 2018 Survey" 
WHERE is_software_dev = 1 AND last_yr_income <= 200000 GROUP BY time_start, school_degree 
 LIMIT 10000;

SELECT year AS __timestamp, name AS name, sum(na_sales) AS "North America", sum(eu_sales) AS "Europe", sum(jp_sales) AS "Japan", sum(other_sales) AS "Other" 
FROM public.video_game_sales 
WHERE rank <= 10 GROUP BY name, year ORDER BY "North America" DESC 
 LIMIT 50000;

SELECT publisher AS publisher, sum(global_sales) AS "SUM(Global_Sales)" 
FROM public.video_game_sales 
WHERE rank <= 25 GROUP BY publisher ORDER BY "SUM(Global_Sales)" DESC 
 LIMIT 50000;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS __timestamp, deal_size AS deal_size, sum(sales) AS "(Sales)" 
FROM public.cleaned_sales_data 
WHERE order_date >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2003-01-01 00:00:00.000000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') AND order_date < TO_TIMESTAMP('2005-06-01 00:00:00.000000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') GROUP BY deal_size, DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) ORDER BY "(Sales)" DESC 
 LIMIT 50000;

SELECT order_date AS __timestamp, product_line AS product_line, sum(sales) AS "(Sales)" 
FROM public.cleaned_sales_data GROUP BY product_line, order_date ORDER BY "(Sales)" DESC 
 LIMIT 50000

SELECT short_phrase AS short_phrase, sum(value) AS "Value" 
FROM public.unicode_test 
WHERE dttm >= TO_DATE('1926-11-18', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND dttm < TO_DATE('2026-11-18', 'YYYY-MM-DD') GROUP BY short_phrase ORDER BY short_phrase ASC 
 LIMIT 50000;

SELECT "DEPT_ID" AS "DEPT_ID", AVG("2004") AS "Boys" 
FROM public.birth_france_by_region GROUP BY "DEPT_ID" 
 LIMIT 100000

SELECT country_name AS country_name, sum("SP_POP_TOTL") AS "sum__SP_POP_TOTL", sum("SP_RUR_TOTL_ZS") AS "sum__SP_RUR_TOTL_ZS", sum("SH_DYN_AIDS") AS "sum__SH_DYN_AIDS" 
FROM public.wb_health_population 
WHERE year >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2011-01-01 00:00:00.000000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') AND year < TO_TIMESTAMP('2012-01-01 00:00:00.000000', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') GROUP BY country_name 
 LIMIT 50000
